# List#getItemRecordId breaks when the list id contains '__'

Please comment to claim before starting; check current assignees and linked PRs.

## Context

Surfaced while reviewing #21906 (which restores the six v10 blog `live-preview` demos under #21902) and corroborating `@neo-opus-grace`'s defect-note (`MESSAGE:9280cf67`): a `Neo.list.Base` declared inside a functional component's `createVdom()` without an explicit `id` renders its items and outlines the active row on click, yet `ListModel#onListClick` never selects the clicked record (`aria-selected` remains `"false"` and `select` never fires).

Reproducer (`node --input-type=module` against `dev`):

```text
BROKEN: {
  listId: 'neo-functional-component-1__0',
  item2Id: 'neo-functional-component-1__0__neo-record-2',
  resolvedId: '0',
  details: 'Please select a task'
}
```

## The Problem

1. `Neo.functional.component.Base#generateIds` (`src/functional/component/Base.mjs:426`) assigns `vdom.id = prefix + '__' + count` (e.g. `'neo-functional-component-1__0'`) to any child component descriptor in `createVdom()` that omits an explicit `id`.
2. `Neo.list.Base#getItemId` (`src/list/Base.mjs:765`) builds each `<li>` VDOM ID as `` `${this.id}__${id}` `` — producing `'neo-functional-component-1__0__neo-record-2'`.
3. `Neo.list.Base#getItemRecordId` (`src/list/Base.mjs:814`) extracts the record token via `let itemId = vnodeId.split('__')[1];`. Whenever `this.id` itself contains `'__'`, `.split('__')[1]` returns the list ID's middle segment (`'0'`) instead of the record suffix (`'neo-record-2'`), causing `view.store.get(id)` in `ListModel#onListClick` (`src/selection/ListModel.mjs:72-73`) and `List#onItemClick` (`src/list/Base.mjs:895`) to return `undefined`.

## The Architectural Reality

- `Design authority:` `Neo.list.Base#getItemId` (`src/list/Base.mjs:758-766`) defines the item VDOM ID contract as `` `${this.id}__${id}` ``; `getItemRecordId(vnodeId)` (`src/list/Base.mjs:813-821`) is its exact inverse and must strip `${this.id}__` (or take the segment after the known list prefix) rather than assuming `this.id` contains zero `'__'` characters.
- Check sibling overrides or callers (`git grep getItemRecordId src/`) so any subclass overriding `getItemId` / `getItemRecordId` stays consistent.

## The Fix

1. Update `Neo.list.Base#getItemRecordId(vnodeId)` in `src/list/Base.mjs` so it strips the `` `${this.id}__` `` prefix when `vnodeId` starts with `` `${this.id}__` `` (falling back cleanly to `vnodeId.slice(vnodeId.lastIndexOf('__') + 2)` when called with another list item ID), then passes `itemId` through `this.store.getCanonicalKey(itemId)` when `!this.useInternalId`.
2. Add a Playwright unit test under `test/playwright/unit/` verifying `ListModel` click selection on both a `List` whose `id` contains `'__'` and a `List` rendered inside `defineComponent` `createVdom()` without an explicit `id`.

## Decision Record impact

`none`

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] `Neo.list.Base#getItemRecordId(vnodeId)` resolves the exact record ID (`internalId` when `useInternalId: true`, canonical key when `useInternalId: false`) even when `list.id` contains `'__'` (e.g. `'neo-functional-component-1__0'`).
- [ ] Unit test proves clicking a list item inside a `defineComponent` `createVdom()` `List` (and a standalone `List` with `'__'` in `id`) selects the clicked record via `ListModel` and fires `select` with `{records: [record]}`.
- [ ] Existing list and menu unit specs pass.

## Out of Scope

- Changing `FunctionalBase#generateIds` `'__'` separator convention or silencing `FunctionalBase#processVdomForComponents`'s missing-`id` console error.
- Tree list selection (`#21945`).

## Avoided Traps

- **Splitting on `'__'` and taking `[1]`:** breaks on any composite prefix ID (`parent__0__recordId`). Strip `${this.id}__` first.
